pages.title: Shoe the Horse
pages.text: A few copper ingots and a leather strap are enough to give your mount a steadier step in nasty country.

pages.title: Sure-Footed Travel
pages.text: Horse Hooves let a mount walk on powdered snow instead of plunging through it. They also soften fall damage, which makes them good everyday tack for mountain trails and cold biomes.

pages.title: Frost Walker Enchant
pages.text: Horse Hooves can be enchanted with $(item)Frost Walker$() at the $(thing)Anvil$() from an enchanted book.$(br2)With Frost Walker shoes on, a horse running across water leaves a trail of $(thing)frosted ice$() behind it — the same effect a player gets with frost-walker boots, but tuned for horse-scale movement.

pages.title: Built for Speed
pages.text: The ice trail is optimized for high movement: when a bonded horse hits $(thing)15+ blocks per second$(), the freeze radius keeps pace, so you can sprint across lakes and oceans without leaving gaps.$(br2)Lava is still lava. Frost Walker won't save you there.
